topic: fix meringue that won't whip up to stiff peaks
core_question: What fixes egg whites that won't whip up into stiff meringue peaks?
answer_summary: Make sure the bowl and beaters are completely grease-free (wipe with vinegar or lemon juice), add a pinch of cream of tartar or lemon juice to stabilize the whites, and continue whipping until stiff peaks form.
persona: polite but increasingly frustrated; writing terse one-liners
